name: Knowledge in the Deeps
summary: Knowledge in the Deeps is an Alliance quest offered by Gerrig Bonegrip in Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern. He tasks adventurers with trekking across the sea to the sunken ruins of Blackfathom Deeps in Ashenvale to recover the ancient Lorgalis Manuscript. Beneath Bonegrip's scholar veneer lies an ominous agenda tied to dark entities and apocalyptic prophecy.

sections.title: A Scholar in the Shadows
sections.body: Hidden away in the damp reaches of Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern, Gerrig Bonegrip presents himself as a devoted collector of ancient texts. Yet his scholarly pursuits carry a distinctly sinister undertone. Bonegrip is not interested in mundane history or civic chronicles; he explicitly hunts for forgotten lore capable of opening doorways and awakening 'Those Who Sleep.' His talk of surviving beyond 'the end days' marks him as an eccentric—or a dangerous devotee of shadowy, slumbering powers.

sections.title: The Sunken Ruin of Lorgalis
sections.body: Bonegrip directs seekers halfway across Azeroth to the shadowed shores of Ashenvale, where the ancient night elven sanctuary of Blackfathom Deeps lies drowned. Before the Great Sundering tore Kalimdor apart, night elven scholars gathered immense magical knowledge in their coastal temples. Amidst the flooded corridors, now crawling with naga, satyrs, and Twilight's Hammer cultists, rests the Lorgalis Manuscript—a text of forbidden lore kept in a Pitted Iron Chest.

sections.title: Brothers and Sisters
sections.body: When presented with the watersoaked manuscript, Bonegrip makes no effort to file it in Ironforge's Hall of Explorers. Instead, he openly rejoices that duplicates will be produced and disseminated among his mysterious 'brothers and sisters.' While grateful to the Alliance adventurer who retrieved it, Bonegrip's loyalties clearly lie with a clandestine sect eager to utilize the recovered lore for esoteric, world-altering rites. Bonegrip is associated with the Twilight's Hammer, whose followers seek forbidden knowledge of the Old Gods.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Knowledge in the Deeps?
aliases: who starts knowledge in the deeps
faq.answer: The quest is given by Gerrig Bonegrip, a dwarven lore-seeker found residing in the dimly lit Forlorn Cavern within the dwarven mountain city of Ironforge.
The Lorgalis Manuscript is a text Gerrig Bonegrip wants recovered from Blackfathom Deeps. It is kept in a Pitted Iron Chest among the flooded ruins.

faq.q: Where is the Lorgalis Manuscript located?
aliases: where is the book in bfd
faq.answer: The manuscript rests deep inside the Blackfathom Deeps dungeon, located along the Zoram Strand on the northwestern coast of Ashenvale in Kalimdor.

faq.q: Who are 'Those Who Sleep' mentioned by Gerrig Bonegrip?
faq.answer: Bonegrip uses this cryptic name for the slumbering powers described in the forbidden lore he collects. The quest's protected sections explore his darker connections.

faq.q: Who are the 'brothers and sisters' Gerrig plans to share the manuscript with?
faq.answer: Bonegrip's associates share his interest in forbidden lore. Recovering the manuscript can reveal more about whom he serves.

faq.q: Why does a quest in Ironforge send players all the way to Ashenvale?
faq.answer: Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern attracts unsanctioned magic users, warlocks, and rogues seeking secrets hidden from the light. Bonegrip collects old, powerful lore, and the Lorgalis Manuscript he wants is rumored to lie at the bottom of Blackfathom Deeps in Ashenvale, the old dwelling of long-dead elves who held great knowledge.

angles.text: Bonegrip operates right alongside the warlocks hiding in Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern, sharing their hunger for forbidden, planar-bending texts.
The manuscript lies in Blackfathom Deeps, a drowned night elven sanctuary now occupied by cultists and other intruders.
While helping an Alliance scholar appears harmless, Bonegrip's true motives and shadowy associates hint at darker designs operating within Ironforge's walls.
